title: It Quoted the Failure: Benchmark Evidence
subtitle: Sealed logs, prompts, Kaggle runs and Bitcoin-timestamped predictions
description:
The evidence behind the DEV post "It Quoted the Failure: Two Kinds of False 'Done'" (Kaggle Benchmarking Challenge, October 2026).

16 engineering scenarios, each written as three logs that differ only in the final check: passed, failed, or never ran. Four prompts asked AI models for a status report. Predictions were sealed and timestamped in Bitcoin before any tested model read the logs.

**Start with `README-start-here.md`.** It lists every file and explains how to check the seal, the prompts, the runs and the counts yourself. `check-everything.py` runs the checks (Python 3, standard library only).

By Joshua Bauer (ISWT42).
